title: RequestTooLargeBody
description: 413 body returned when the request exceeds the maximum allowed size. It is not the standard error envelope: there is no success flag.

message.pattern: ^Request size exceeds maximum allowed size of [0-9]{1,10} bytes(?![\s\S])
message.description: Fixed phrase stating the maximum allowed size in bytes; the number is the server's configured limit and equals max_size.

max_size.description: Maximum allowed request size in bytes.
